defender_hit.description: Microsoft Defender or Microsoft Safety Scanner flagged this file or threat

trace_paste_exec.description: RunMRU or PowerShell history contains a pasted download-and-execute command

system_name_wrong_dir.description: Executable is named like a Windows system binary outside Windows directories

lolbin_remote.description: Command line invokes a living-off-the-land binary with an encoded command, URL, or temp script

covered_by_exclusion.description: Target path falls under a Microsoft Defender exclusion

forced_extension.description: Browser extension is force-installed by policy on an unmanaged machine

sig_invalid.description: Authenticode or code signature is invalid, revoked, expired, or hash-mismatched

user_writable_path.description: Target resides in a user-writable directory (AppData, Temp, ProgramData, Public, Downloads, Recycle Bin)

unsigned.description: Executable or script has no Authenticode signature

double_extension.description: Filename uses a deceptive double extension such as .pdf.exe

hidden_or_system_attr.description: File has Hidden/System attributes or scheduled task is marked Hidden

recent.description: File or entry was created within the --since lookback window

orphan.description: Persistence entry points to a file that no longer exists

hijack_debugger.description: Image File Execution Options Debugger hijack is configured

hijack_winlogon.description: Winlogon Shell or Userinit differs from the Windows default

hijack_bootexecute.description: Session Manager BootExecute contains non-standard entries

wmi_persistence.description: Permanent WMI event subscription present in root\subscription

untrusted_root_cert.description: Root CA certificate is not in the Microsoft Trusted Root Program list

defender_disabled_policy.description: Microsoft Defender protection is disabled by policy without another active antivirus

defender_exclusion_risky.description: Defender exclusion covers a broad drive, executable extension, or user-writable folder

browser_policy_unmanaged.description: Browser policy overrides homepage, startup, or search on a non-domain, non-MDM machine

browser_notification_spam.description: Site is granted browser notification permission

browser_sideloaded_extension.description: Browser extension was sideloaded or unpacked outside the official web store

proxy_configured.description: Manual proxy server or PAC auto-configuration URL is active

hosts_modified.description: Non-localhost entry present in the system hosts file

hosts_security_block.description: Hosts file blocks or redirects Microsoft, Windows Update, or security vendor domains

remote_access_tool.description: Known remote-access tool is installed (verify you recognize it)

known_bundleware.description: Known adware, bundleware, or potentially unwanted program is installed

mac_unsigned_or_adhoc.description: macOS binary is unsigned or ad-hoc signed

mac_not_notarized.description: macOS binary is not notarized by Apple

mac_user_writable_or_hidden.description: macOS target lives in a hidden, temp, or user-writable path

mac_random_label.description: Launch item label appears random or non-standard

mac_shell_curl_pipe.description: Launch item or cron entry invokes a shell/script with network download or encoded payload

mac_suspicious_profile.description: Configuration profile sets browser homepage, search, extensions, proxy, or DNS on an unmanaged Mac

mac_posture_weakened.description: macOS Gatekeeper or System Integrity Protection (SIP) is disabled
